payload.posture: Read Genesis 42:25–28 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states joseph commands provisions and restored money; the discovery in one sack turns the brothers’ attention toward what God has done. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
